description: Utah Division of Corporations and Commercial Code business entity registry (access review; no bulk file found) for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/sources/ut-sos-entities.md.

sources.publisher: Utah Department of Commerce, Division of Corporations and Commercial Code
sources.license: Public records: the Division's 'Public Disclosure of Information' page (read 2026-11-03) says 'Information about a business that registers with the Division is public information' and that its registration records 'are classified as public records pursuant to GRAMA' (Utah Code 63G-2-201(2): a record is public unless a statute says otherwise). The page says nothing about bulk data, lists or downloads and refers readers to the Department of Commerce's Access to Government Records page
sources.gate: Records request: no free bulk file was found (the old open data portal address opendata.utah.gov answers "Domain Decommissioned"). A person must ask the Division of Corporations whether a bulk extract is sold, or file a GRAMA request (Utah Code 63G-2) for the registry data.
sources.notes: Only an interactive Business Entity Search and a 'Business Entity List' builder were found, both per search results; automating either is scraping an application and is not done. Nothing was downloaded.
